import pandas as pd

def generate_signals(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    # Initialize the position series
    position = pd.Series(0, index=df.index)
    
    # Calculate %K(12)
    def stochastic_k(close, high, low, n=12):
        hh = high.rolling(window=n).max()
        ll = low.rolling(window=n).min()
        k = 100 * (close - ll) / (hh - ll)
        k[k.isnull()] = 50
        return k
    
    # Iterate over each bar
    for i in range(len(df)):
        k = stochastic_k(df['close'].iloc[:i+1], df['high'].iloc[:i+1], df['low'].iloc[:i+1])
        
        # Update position based on current %K(12) value
        if position.iat[i-1] == 0:  # Flat
            position.iat[i] = -1 if k.iloc[i] < 12 else 0
        elif position.iat[i-1] == 1:  # Long
            position.iat[i] = 0 if k.iloc[i] > 45 else position.iat[i-1]
        
    return position
